title: Wooden Chisel
body:
Removed
The following content has been removed from the game or does not exist.

Reason: Removed early on in development

Description

Wooden Chisel was a chisel that new players were supposed to recieve at the start of the game. It was supposed to be worst chisel in the game, being also sold at The Oak Depot.

Chisels are tools used to slice refined and forged ores into pieces and shave rocks to fit into processors. Do note, that shaving will reduce yield of the ore/rock, so it's adviced to save them to be processed in a bigger machine later.

This chisel was removed very early on in development due to being unneeded, as it barely had any significant stat differences compared to the Rusty Chisel.

Appearance

Wooden Chisel, like the name implies, is a typical looking chisel made entirely out of wood.

It's handle is made out of dark brown wood. Blade is yellow in color with the same material applied to it.

Trivia

  • Chisels are the only tools that do not have their stats listed in their descriptions, probably due to to the fact different tiers of chisels only vary in speed they can slice/shave an ore.
  • This tool is a part of the group of removed starter tools. Those being the Wooden Axe, Wooden Saw and Wooden Pickaxe.
